entries.headline: E-3G SENTRY60 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing E-3G Sentry using callsign SENTRY60, hex AE11EB and registration 80-0138, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by DVS-135 via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: EAM header code VQPFO7 reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble with code VQPFO7.

entries.headline: USAF transports and elevated coded radio traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and elevated coded radio traffic near the United Kingdom and the Korea-Japan region.

entries.headline: U-2 DRGN21 spotted
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Lockheed U-2 using callsign DRGN21, hex AE096B and registration 80-1099, citing a sighting by reagan0965.

entries.headline: Four USAF transports, two command jets and seven broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States alongside two nuclear command aircraft, after seven coded military radio broadcasts earlier that day.

entries.headline: USAF transports and continuing coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and continuing coded radio broadcasts.

entries.headline: C-32B 00-9001 spotted without a callsign
entries.summary: War Watch identified a Boeing C-32B with no callsign shown, hex AE0443 and registration 00-9001, citing a sighting by reagan0965 and a photo by Justin Stöckel via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Civil airliner escorted to Nuremberg after 7500 squawk
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a DW report that a civil airliner over Germany accidentally transmitted squawk code 7500, was escorted by German Air Force aircraft to Nuremberg Airport, and was met by police.

entries.headline: Six USAF cargo aircraft and elevated Korea-Japan activity
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force cargo aircraft airborne over the continental United States and military flight activity near Korea and Japan at nearly five times normal.

entries.headline: USAF transports and elevated Korea-Japan activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and Europe, with activity near Korea and Japan at nearly 4.5 times normal.

entries.headline: Six USAF cargo aircraft and support activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force cargo aircraft airborne over the continental United States and North Sea, alongside multiple refueling tankers and surveillance aircraft tracked during the day.

entries.headline: Six USAF transports amid elevated flight activity
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States as military flight activity ran nearly 3.3 times above normal.
